<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope—multiple peaks spaced ~1.003 Da apart with a decreasing intensity pattern characteristic of the natural 13C distribution—we can definitively identify carbon in the sample. No other element shows its distinctive isotopic signature (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
